name: Your Company
tagline: A contemporary art gallery in Tashkent: new names, big exhibitions, open to everyone
niche: Contemporary art gallery: exhibitions, talks, artwork sales

seo.title: Your Company — contemporary art gallery in Tashkent
seo.description: Exhibitions of artists from Uzbekistan and Central Asia, talks, tours and artwork sales. Tue–Sun 11:00–20:00, 74 Yahyo Gulyamov St.
seo.answer: Your Company is a contemporary art gallery at 74 Yahyo Gulyamov Street in Tashkent, open Tuesday to Sunday from 11:00 to 20:00. Exhibition entry is 50,000 sum, free for students and children under 12; a curator-led tour is 150,000 sum. Works from the exhibitions are for sale: prices on request from the gallery manager.

sections.title: Warm Wind: paintings by Kamila Yunusova
sections.eyebrow: Kamila Yunusova · “Warm Wind”, 2026 · oil on canvas · until 14 December
sections.subtitle: Thirty large canvases about summer in Tashkent: sun-bleached walls, the shade of plane trees and colour that stays in your memory. The artist’s first solo show.

sections.label: Gallery
sections.title: A place where art happens now
sections.text: Your Company opened in 2018 in a former sewing workshop on Yahyo Gulyamov Street. 600 square metres of white walls, high ceilings and light from the roof. We show artists from Uzbekistan and Central Asia — from first solo shows to large retrospectives — host talks and help collectors find works.

items.title: Warm Wind
items.text: A first solo show: thirty canvases about the city in summer.

items.title: Light and Dust
items.text: Twelve photographers on the roads of the Fergana Valley.

items.title: Noise
items.text: Installations that listen to the viewer: sound, light and movement.

items.title: Clay
items.text: Rishtan ceramics alongside works by young sculptors.

items.title: Curator-led tour
items.text: An hour through the exhibition with the curator: how the works came about and what to look for. Groups up to 15.

items.title: Talks
items.text: Talks on Central Asian and contemporary art for those just starting out.

items.title: Kids’ studio
items.text: Sessions for children aged 6–12 inspired by the current show: we look, discuss and draw.

items.title: Buying works
items.text: We’ll help you choose a work and arrange paperwork and delivery. Prices on request.

items.quote: Came for half an hour and stayed for three. Finally Tashkent has a place like this.
items.author: Nigora

items.quote: The curator’s tour opened the show to me anew: I saw the canvases, but only understood them after the conversation.
items.author: Jamshid

items.quote: We bought the first work for our collection — the gallery helped with the paperwork and the frame.
items.author: Elena and Rustam
